answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the haven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
